Messages.Author: Scott Anderson
Messages.Body:
i just started playing v:tes and i got an astrid thomas in a starter.on
astrid it says that all voting tremere must vote with astrid.after i read
the rule book i was under the impression that only methuselahs vote.

so my question is:do vampires, methuselahs, or both get votes.

Messages.Author: Faethor
Messages.Body:
>so my question is:do vampires, methuselahs, or both get votes.

The methuselah (controling player) decides how his vampires will
vote. The votes come from the vampires (or cards), though. As
oxymoronic as it may seem, a methuselah can have some of his vamps vote
yes, some vote no. >shrug<

-j

Messages.Author: Michael Kelly
Messages.Body:
Scott Anderson wrote:
>
> i just started playing v:tes and i got an astrid thomas in a starter.on
> astrid it says that all voting tremere must vote with astrid.after i read
> the rule book i was under the impression that only methuselahs vote.
>
> so my question is:do vampires, methuselahs, or both get votes.

Both. Vampires get votes from titles, reacton cards, and action modifier cards.
Methuselahs get votes from the vote cards.
